items.title: Ombré Teens
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
Basque in this gorgeously colorful trend - ombré color patterns!

- Hand-crafted HD skins
- One skin free!
- By 57Digital

items.title: Planet Teens
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
You're out of this world... literally! Pick your favorite planet and become their personification. Are you a cold Neptune or a boiling Venus? Show off the best planets to your friends with the Planet Teens skin pack.

- 10 otherworldly skins
- By 57Digital

items.title: Eye Mouth Eye
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
Take a peek into the land of eyes and mouths, make your friends wonder which way you're looking and where you're speaking from, and live in a strange world with the Eye Mouth Eye skin pack. It's time to take staring to a new level.

- 10 skins
- Eye see what you did there!
- By 57Digital

items.title: Mobsters
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
A skeleton or a zombie, a slime or a spider... With a mix like this, you can be any kind of mobster you like. With a mix of teens and mobs, how could you go wrong? Be the jock of the mobs or the nerd, what do you want to be?

- 10 skins
- Mooshroom and sheep included!
- By 57Digital

items.title: Choice Light x Dark
items.creator: inPixel
items.description:
Everyone has a different side to them, which one do you choose? Join the dark side and party all night, never sleep or join the light side and set your spirit free! Stop dreaming and be the best!

- 12 cool skins
- 6 dark and 6 light
- By inPixel

items.title: Trendy Winter
items.creator: ThunderAy
items.description:
Ready for the snowy season? Now you are! The freezing cold won't be a problem anymore, hot and stylish the winter style is all of your choice! You will rock the party games!

+ 1 FREE skin included!
+ 12 trendy winter skins!
+ By Senior Studios & Blackstone Studios!

items.title: Warrior Knights
items.creator: ThunderAy
items.description:
Turn back time and enjoy the medieval times, leading the cavalry to victory!
Prepare to defend your kingdom and let the battle begin!

+ 16 skins, providing you with the bravest knights and warriors!
+ By Senior Studios & GabCreates!

items.title: Anime Pajama Teens
items.creator: In Mine
items.description:
Pajama pillow wars, yay! Are you ready to join the game with your amazing nap time pajama suited for intense pillow fights? Tailored with love, these skins will bring you joy and laughter to your friends.

+ Teens
+ Students
+ Pajama
+ 1 free skin
+ By In mine

items.title: Anime Fashion Teens
items.creator: In Mine
items.description:
What would be your perfect look? Choose from these anime and parkour fashion style skins. Let your character be an absolute celebrity by choosing one of these.

+ Teen anime fashion
+ Parkour style look
+ 1 free skin
+ By In Mine

items.title: Legendary Ninjas
items.creator: In Mine
items.description:
Are you ready to play as a legendary master ninja? Will you prove that you are worthy of your title? Choose your fighter and join the game, show your best skills!

+ Anime ninjas
+ Shinobi look
+ 1 free skin
+ By In Mine

items.title: Cobs and Prisoners
items.creator: Mine-North
items.description:
Play with your friends and catch the prisoners or be a officer who keeps the city save. Be the bad guy and hide form the Police.

+ Police skins
+ Prisoner skins

Created by Mine-North

items.title: Elegant Mobs
items.creator: Netherpixel
items.description:
Have you seen mobs and wished to be like them? Here are some elegant mobs to fulfill your desire.

- Twelve elegant mobs
- One skin totally free
- By DragonClub Studios

items.title: Tainted 2
items.creator: Blu Shutter Bug
items.description:
These skins are rocking black and white designs but something's not quite right. These skins are tainted! With evil glowing red eyes you never know what mischief they might be up to. Tread carefully now, before you become tainted!

- 10 skins
- By: Blu Shutter Bug

items.title: SPEEDRUNNER VS HUNTERS!
items.creator: Chunklabs
items.description:
Play as a team of hunters against one speedrunner in this challenging minigame! The hunter needs to kill the speedrunner before the speedrunner is able to reach the end.
-Reach the end as fast as possible!
-Use a compass to find the speedrunner!
!This map requires at least two players

items.title: Anime Fashion
items.creator: Entity Builds
items.description:
We're bringing the fancy outfits of fashion to the fun colorful designs of the anime world in one epic skin pack mashup! Bringing to you, Anime Fashion skin pack where you pick from a variety of fun and exciting fashionable anime-designed outfits. Dress up to explore a city, play mini-games or take on the Ender Dragon!

~Mashup of two popular themes
~10 eye-catching skins

items.title: Skyblock Lucky Block: Rainbow
items.creator: Blocky
items.description:
Rainbow Lucky Block and Skyblock combined! Open Rainbow Lucky Blocks to get 150+ rewards and explore the 50+ Skyblock islands!
By Blocky

items.title: Blingy Champions
items.creator: Team Visionary
items.description:
Reign supreme as the number one champion in fashion and blingy goodness. You're always out there, setting the latest trends, making the headline pages of all the most prestigious fashion magazines. You are the diamond in the ruff, a true gem to modern fashion and culture. You are a true champion!

+ 1 free skin
+ 12 skins
+ By Team Visionary

items.title: Modern Life 2021
items.creator: Team Visionary
items.description:
The urban trends are hitting the streets, you and your friends are the first to adorn these latest trends, making you the coolest kids! Watch as the other kids try to keep up with you and your squad, while you kick back and relax and enjoy the good life.

+ 1 free skin
+ 12 skins
+ By Team Visionary

items.title: Ninja Mobs
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
Be the ultimate mob ninja and hide from your friends! Move among the shadows, and never let your guard down!

- 8 ninja mob skins!

This skin set includes:

- Creeper
- Skeleton
- Spider
- Enderman
- Zombie
- Slime
- Pig
- Piglin

items.title: Cyber Suits
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
Charge up and dash out with the latest in cyber suit technology! Colorful power armor that will make you impossible to miss!

- 8 unique skins!
- Cool geometric patterns with cyberpunk inspired designs!

items.title: End Game
items.creator: Blockception
items.description:
Welcome to the End Game. 

Battle it out with these glitched out gaming endermen! Ready up for duo PVP, dominating the leaderboards or having all eyes on your glitched out skin. The sky is your limit!

- Choose from 15 glitchy skins!

items.title: Cliffside Mansion
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Treat yourself and your friends to a luxury mansion with an amazing view. There are all sorts of beautiful rooms high above the clouds in this amazing mansion.

- Great with friends!
- An amazing view
- Perfect start for survival

items.title: Ben 10
items.creator: Minecraft
items.description:
Become the hero you were always destined to be! Transform into all 10 of Ben’s alien heroes, including Four Arms, Heatblast, and XLR8 in a BEN 10 Minecraft adventure. Defeat Ben’s toughest villains and save the day with your very own Omnitrix! It's Hero Time! Includes Story and Free Roam modes, plus 6 skins!
- By Blockception

items.title: Marinettes Wardrobe
items.creator: Team Phoenix Studio
items.description: Welcome to Marinette's Wardrobe! Change her style to suit your mood. More wardrobes to come!
